description: This source file contains test cases for the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter component, specifically testing its decision logic for prompting and fallback behaviors in different security and session scenarios.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompterTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter, assessing session matching, prompting logic, and fallback decision-making.

methods.name: session match prefers active session
methods.description: Tests whether the system correctly presents prompts based on active session matching.

methods.name: session fallback uses recent activity
methods.description: Verifies prompt presentation when active session is nil, considering recent activity timeout.

methods.name: default behavior matches mode
methods.description: Checks prompt behavior depending on local or remote mode when no session info is provided.

methods.name: askAlwaysPromptsRegardlessOfSecurity
methods.description: Tests that prompts are always shown when ask setting is 'always' regardless of security level.

methods.name: askOnMissPromptsOnlyForAllowlist
methods.description: Tests that prompts are shown only when security is 'allowlist' and ask setting is 'onMiss'.

methods.name: askOffNeverPrompts
methods.description: Ensures that prompts are never shown when ask setting is 'off' regardless of security level.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistAllowsMatchingResolvedPath
methods.description: Checks that allowlist patterns correctly allow command execution when the resolved path matches.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistDeniesAllowlistMiss
methods.description: Verifies denial when allowlist patterns do not match the command's resolved path.

methods.name: fallbackFullAllowsWhenPromptCannotBeShown
methods.description: Ensures that fallback decision defaults to allow when prompts cannot be shown and no allowlist is provided.
